description: This file contains unit tests for various UI components and controllers within the macOS app, utilizing SwiftUI, AppKit, and testing frameworks. It tests building view bodies, presenting/dismissing overlays, and updating UI elements.

classes.name: LowCoverageViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of UI component tests for macOS app components including context menu views, settings toggles, voice wake tests, agent event window, overlays, hosting views, dock icon management, and voice wake settings.

methods.name: context menu card builds body
methods.description: Tests the construction and rendering of alternative states for the ContextMenuCardView.

methods.name: settings toggle row builds body
methods.description: Tests the creation of a SettingsToggleRow view with a toggle binding.

methods.name: voice wake test card builds body across states
methods.description: Tests VoiceWakeTestCard rendering across different test states and whether UI updates correctly.

methods.name: agent events window builds body with event
methods.description: Populates the agent event store with a sample event and tests the AgentEventsWindow body rendering.

methods.name: notify overlay presents and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presenting and dismissing a notification overlay, including a delay for visibility.

methods.name: talk overlay presents twice and dismisses
methods.description: Tests overlay presentation, update, and dismissal with delay.

methods.name: visual effect view hosts in NS hosting view
methods.description: Tests embedding a VisualEffectView in an NSHostingView and checking size updates.

methods.name: menu hosted item hosts content
methods.description: Tests embedding menu content inside an NSHostingView and updating.

methods.name: dock icon manager updates visibility
methods.description: Tests dock icon visibility management including setting user defaults and updating visibility.

methods.name: voice wake settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Calls helper functions for voice wake settings testing.

methods.name: debug settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Executes debugging helper functions, including async operations.
